observes: AUDITD: 08 Cypher UNWIND of 3,000 rows creates 3,000 nodes; the same with a 64,001-char value in the last row raises GraphWriteError SQLCODE -104 'nothing written' and leaves 0 nodes and 0 props (all or nothing holds). 15 with 40,000 temporal edges whose ids carry 40 extra characters (window JSON past 3,641,144): get_edges_in_window raises TemporalWindowError naming the limit and iter_edges_in_window (paged) returns 40,000 (documented, module 05); prov_export of the whole window, prov_as_dict of ONE edge and prov_export_from_cypher of ONE node all raise RuntimeError '<MAXSTRING>QueryWindow+27^Graph.KG.TemporalIndex.1'; prov_export of a one-second window succeeds (1 activity)
